clips.title: The story
paras: Bromos Grummner is a dwarven paladin trainer stationed in Anvilmar within Coldridge Valley. He mentors fledgling dwarven holy warriors, preaching steadfast faith in the Holy Light and the vital bond between dwarves and humans in the Knights of the Silver Hand.

Standing within the sturdy stone hall of Anvilmar, Bromos Grummner welcomes dwarven novices drawn to the discipline of the Holy Light. Confident and resolute, he instructs young paladins in martial rites and sacred invocations. Beyond the basic tenets of combat, Bromos emphasizes unity, reminding his pupils that the order of the Knights of the Silver Hand bridges the realms of Ironforge and the human kingdoms of the Alliance in righteous purpose.
